title: Spacious Home Close to Everything!
description:
Tons of space and centrally located. 
5 minutes from the airport.
5 minutes from Opryland (Grand Ole Opry, Opry Mills Mall and Opryland Hotel).
10 minutes from downtown.

The space
My home is just a few minutes away from the airport and 10 minutes away from Downtown (Broadway, Ascend Amphitheater, The Ryman, Bridgestone Arena, Titans' stadium) and Opry Mills/Grand Ole Opry.

It's a great house for work trips OR for groups of friends on vacation OR for families traveling together. Even though it's really close to the heart of the city, it is on a quiet street in a very peaceful neighborhood. The full stainless and quartz kitchen with the open concept is great for for cooking meals at home.
All three bedrooms have brand new beds. There's a queen-sized air mattress available on request that can be put in the living room or master bedroom.

Permit # 2018037271

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire upstairs, deck and back yard. The downstairs/garage are used for storage.

Other things to note
If you have a special request, please let me know as far in advance as possible so I can try to accommodate them. 

No smoking in the house but you can smoke on the patio. You are responsible for disposing of your cigarette butts. Please DO NOT flick them into the yard!
